open.label: Saying I’m annoyed, calmly
open.belief: If I tell someone I’m annoyed, even calmly, then it’ll turn into an argument.
open.x: They’ll get defensive, and it’ll turn into a much bigger thing.
open.test: Say one thing that annoyed you, in one sentence, calmly. Then stop talking.
open.drop: Don’t raise your voice, and don’t bring up a second thing.

done.label: Saying no without an excuse
done.belief: If I say no and don’t explain myself, then people will think I’m selfish.
done.x: There’ll be a pause, and they’ll be a bit off with me afterwards.
done.test: Say “No, I can’t this time” to one small request today.
done.drop: No reason, no apology, no softening it.
done.o: He said fair enough and got his own coffee.

done.label: Not being the funny one
done.belief: If I stop being the entertaining one, then people won’t want me around.
done.x: The conversation will flatten out and they’ll drift off to someone else.
done.test: For one conversation today, just listen and ask questions. No jokes.
